title: Zesty Spanish Tuna Patatas Bravas
description: A fresh and snappy solo dinner dish featuring tuna and patatas bravas, originating from the Valencian region of Spain, suitable for diabetic diets
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the diced potatoes for 10 minutes or until they are slightly tender
Drain the potatoes and set them aside to cool
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and saute the diced onion and minced garlic until they are softened
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the cooked potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and spice mixture
Add the canned tuna to the skillet and stir to combine with the potatoes and onion mixture
Add the tomato sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with the tuna and potato mixture
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes or until the flavors have melded together
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed
Serve the Zesty Spanish Tuna Patatas Bravas hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired
